description: Deletes or removes an identified BRC sales invoice after explicit confirmation using the invoice's current concurrency timestamp. confirmWrite is the confirmation field; confirmDelete is a legacy compatibility alias. Requires a valid routeToken issued for the matching action workflow. The token remains valid through lookup, preview and the permitted transaction. Placeholder tokens are invalid. A routeToken does not bypass preview or explicit-confirmation requirements. A call without confirmWrite: true returns confirmation_required and a payload preview. confirmWrite: true applies the previewed change after explicit confirmation. Passing preflight is not confirmation.

companyName.description: Company context name, for example YOUR-COMPANY-NAME.

confirmDelete.description: Legacy alias for confirmWrite; either confirmation flag is sufficient.

confirmWrite.description: Explicit confirmation of the previewed invoice deletion.

connectionRef.description: Opaque Red connection reference returned by brc_confirm_company_connection. Pass this exact value on every later tool call when the MCP client rotates session ids (for example Vibe/Mistral). Keep reusing the same connectionRef after successful tool calls — do not start a new connection because a lookup returned empty or partial data. It is not an API key and does not contain credentials.

routeToken.description: Opaque routeToken from brc_route_request for this action workflow. Required for transactional tools. Routing permission only — does not replace preview-before-posting or confirmWrite.

name: brc_delete_sales_invoice
title: Delete Sales Invoice
